engine.name: llama.cpp b6000 (4762ad7316dcdec20016ab5985fb46a27902204d), CPU, through keramos/adapters/llamacpp/llamacpp_adapter.cpp (a JSON Lines shim over llama.h; GCC 13.3, -O2; llama.cpp Release, GGML_NATIVE off, AVX2, shared libraries, WSL ext4)
engine.environment: the runner under CPython 3.12.3, numpy 2.3.3, WSL (Ubuntu 24.04)
engine.run: python3 tools/ir_conformance.py --adapter "cmd:llamacpp_adapter --threads 2 --alias mistral=llama", keramos working tree equal to v1.2.1 (92b89f0b) plus adapters/llamacpp, 2026-10-27. Settings: f32 kv cache, flash attention off, swa_full on (llama_context_default_params), n_ubatch 512. Adapter rewrites: tokenizer.ggml.model 'word' -> 'no_vocab' with <arch>.vocab_size (kv overrides; the file is read unchanged), and tp_mistral's architecture 'mistral' loaded as 'llama' (llama.cpp has no 'mistral' architecture; its converter writes Mistral as 'llama'; without --alias the two tp_mistral cases are skips). Skips: files of architecture 'paperkiln' (no llama.cpp graph, IR_SPEC 9.1: 28 cases, model 10 and trace 18, 4 of the traces reported 'not implemented' by the runner's score_form fallback), open with a replacement document (4 traces), IR validation (refuse 83, accept 34), single nodes (op 59, grad 8), digest (84), render_chat (32). Every FAIL is classified in adapters/llamacpp/FINDINGS.txt.
